rationale: The original (fabricated) citation claims a CRISPR-Cas9 off-target prediction model. Doench et al. 2016 is the canonical paper for that exact claim — sgRNA design rules with off-target minimization are the paper's headline contribution. The fit is direct and well-supported.
concerns: The fabricated citation specified Nature Biotechnology 2020; the real Doench paper is Nature Biotechnology 2016 — same venue, four years earlier. Author should confirm the year shift is acceptable for the claim being supported.
